added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

assertion_audit.capacity: Reducing null_capacity to one with three candidates must return CAPACITY and NaN membership.
assertion_audit.implicit_tangent: Quadratic stationary-point tangent has analytic and central-difference controls; booked-current kernel tangents are deferred expected failures.
assertion_audit.limiter: Former chord wall enters the zero-flux plasma and violates the edge invariant; mutation and repaired receipts are retained.
assertion_audit.membership: Independent analytic symmetric-difference quadrature breaches fixed amplitude coefficients on excess support error; live read-area reconstruction cross-check also asserts agreement.
assertion_audit.order: Historical JSON alone supplies the fit; no change to topology.py can affect this assertion.
assertion_audit.position: Three-pitch mutation fails one-pitch assertions in both analytic cases; original cases pass.
assertion_audit.representation: Replacing fit_inverse by zeros must refuse with SINGULAR_REPRESENTATION.
assertion_audit.tracing: Eager versus jit/vmap comparison detects numerical disagreement beyond 2e-12; it does not demand bitwise identity.

findings.text: blocking: test_saddle_support_order loads committed limited/diverted-physical-rows.json and fits their historical smooth_max values without calling read or any current support implementation. Thus restoring a first-order reconstruction leaves both tests green. The live amplitude test reports current orders but does not assert them, and topology.read at line 2902 always installs the moving radius floor, so the fixed-radius arm required by the two-arm ruling has no current executable acceptance path. Add a current-code fixed-radius measurement arm and demonstrate that an order-breaking mutation fails; retain the JSON as before-arm evidence.

follow-on: baseline_suite is empty. The canonical comparison therefore yields added_failure_count=null and added_failure_ids=[], not a measured zero; bind a completed baseline and corresponding after gate before claiming regression neutrality.

follow-on: Adding topology changes the public policy field tuple, while tests/test_forward_solve_request.py:72 still asserts the previous tuple. The reviewed manifest explicitly assigns this repair to the coordinator; integrate that repair before claiming the request-schema gate is green. This failure is outside the final topology-module gate and is not invented as an added_failure_id.

follow-on: Ten kernel qualification rows are strict expected failures from the shared measured 600-second compile timeout. Preserve that distinction during promotion and complete the independently owned kernel repair and qualification before marking the whole topology section done; the record supplies no kernel-backed 2616-cell cold compile, executable-size or numerical qualification result.
follow-on: The expected-failure reason embeds cfs-kernel-compile-cost, a plan-node identifier, in source. Replace it with the compiler mechanism and keep the node ownership in the evidence document.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the aggregate production and acceptance changes against 7c4a76cafa41f4f5a4da06af19a0f0aac3271560 and the 53-commit inventory; the implementation, fixture repair, test controls and retained historical evidence are coherent with the subsequent partial-scope rulings, subject to the order-guard finding.
item_verdicts.done_when: docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/cfs-topology-read.html:722 accurately limits the final H200 gate to 25 passed and 10 compiler-barrier expected failures, but tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py:1925 checks historical JSON rather than the current implementation for the required fixed-radius order arm.
item_verdicts.goal: nova/equilibrium/topology.py:2889 provides the traced read and solve_request.py:232 extends the existing policy owner; assess this as the live plan's authorised partial landing, with kernel qualification and consumer retirement still outstanding.
item_verdicts.manifest: The reviewed run's manifest.md records all 53 commits and an after_suite at 1c88579b58406157f85e1869e223a2af6235ed8e; baseline_suite is empty, so added failures are unmeasured, not zero, and all later commits through the reviewed head change evidence only.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The 105-path base-to-head diff stays within the original five grants plus scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py and tests/test_analytic_oracle_limiter_wall.py, explicitly authorised by the live plan's oracle-wall ruling; the stored original node grant still needs coordinator reconciliation.

justifications.durability: test_topology_read.py:1933 cannot detect a topology order regression because it reads fixed JSON, although the live amplitude, capacity, singular-representation and translated-position controls would fail on their respective regressions.
justifications.evidence: The final H200 receipt at cfs-topology-read.html:722 is reproducibly bound to its raw log and the position mutation fails both cases, while test_topology_read.py:1933 reads banked measurements and the reviewed manifest supplies no baseline suite.
justifications.fit: topology.py:2218 and solve_request.py:232 use the repository's dataclass pytrees and traced refusal conventions, but test_topology_read.py:39 embeds a plan-node identifier in a source reason string contrary to the naming rule.
justifications.goal_fidelity: topology.py:2889 and the partial landing at cfs-topology-read.html:722 deliver the requested authority primitives and operands, but the order clause is not exercised against current code and the original full kernel-backed goal remains explicitly deferred.
justifications.reuse: topology.py:2391 reuses AtomicCellMesh, :2459 reuses build_contour_mesh, :2913 calls build_contour_tree and :2282 calls packed_analytic_moments; the evidence at cfs-topology-read.html:719 explains why sampled-flux Null1D/Null2D cannot supply the required kernel jets, while the new conic-fragment and normal-form code addresses capabilities the old one-crossing clip does not provide.
justifications.scope_discipline: All 105 changed paths are within the five original grants and the two fixture paths authorised in the live converged-forward-solve.html oracle-wall ruling; no Biot implementation or production consumer outside that scope changed.

limitations: No product suite rerun: independent source and recorded-evidence review.
Missing baseline_suite prevents a measured added-failure count.
Kernel-backed qualification and production cutover remain deferred.
